title: Experimental approaches to data generation for REACH compliance of multi-walled carbon nanotubes: human health in vitro/in chemico
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, 13,1523-1533
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN01019E, Paper
Open Access

Marie-Léonie Bohlen, Hyun Pyo Jeon, Hana Jo, Yeojin Lee, Jan Oltmanns
This research evaluates the applicability of standardised animal-free human health tests to solid MWCNTs, highlighting the critical need for nano-specific guidance to ensure regulatory applicability.
